title: April 5th House Armed Services Hearing on UFOs
description:
On the 5th of April 1966, the US House of Representatives Armed Services Committee conducted a hearing on UFOs.  Project Blue Book consultant Astronomer J Allen Hynek delivered a lengthy prepared statement, which will be addressed elsewhere on the channel.  It was his comments to reporters at the end of the hearing on what should be done with 20 unique unexplained cases to which I'd like to bring your attention.
